sentences.en: Three long-term inmates of the state penitentiary have just escaped.
sentences.zh: 刚刚有三位长期服刑的犯人越狱了。

sentences.en: I am a person in long-term recovery from drug addiction.
sentences.zh: 我是一名戒毒康复期长达数年的病人。

sentences.en: Feedback is something without which healthy, long-term communication is impossible.
sentences.zh: 没有反馈，健康的长期沟通是不可能的。
